# ui::testing::TestJumpListHost

Header: `winui/testing/TestJumpListHost.hpp`.

Derives from `ui::JumpListHost`.

[JumpListHost](../tree/jump-list-host.md) test double: touches no jump list, and keeps the tasks it was handed and every recent file.

Install it with [set_jump_list_host()](namespace-ui-testing.md#set_jump_list_host); [ui::set_jump_list()](../tree/namespace-ui.md#set_jump_list) and [ui::add_recent_file()](../tree/namespace-ui.md#add_recent_file) then reach it. It uninstalls itself when destroyed.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::testing::TestJumpListHost jump_list;
ui::testing::set_jump_list_host(&jump_list);

ui::set_jump_list({ui::JumpTask{.title = "New window", .arguments = "--new-window"}});
ui::add_recent_file("notes.txt");
REQUIRE(jump_list.tasks.size() == 1);
REQUIRE(jump_list.recent_files.size() == 1);
```
